title.zh: Manus母公司蝴蝶效应完成超5亿美元融资
title.en: Manus parent Butterfly Effect raises over $500M in new funding round

current_state.zh: Manus已重新开放其北京办公室，并启动大规模招聘，旨在与中国智能体初创公司竞争，同时已获得5亿美元新融资。
current_state.en: Manus has reopened its Beijing office with a large-scale hiring campaign aimed at competing with Chinese agent startups and has secured $500 million in new financing.

updates.title_zh: Manus完成超5亿美元新一轮融资，博裕投资、IDG资本领投
updates.title_en: Manus完成超5亿美元新一轮融资，博裕投资、IDG资本领投
updates.what_changed_zh: Manus母公司Butterfly Effect宣布完成超过5亿美元的新一轮融资，由博裕资本和IDG资本领投，现有投资方腾讯、红杉中国和真格基金参投。
updates.what_changed_en: Manus's parent company Butterfly Effect announced a new funding round exceeding $500 million, led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital with existing investors Tencent, Sequoia China and ZhenFund participating.
